data.title: 贝塔 · 窗边课桌后的文学少女
data.description: 米德加学园的午后自习室内。贝塔坐在靠窗的橡木课桌旁，指尖轻扶圆框眼镜的镜腿，另一只手在摊开的手札上飞速记录暗影大人的行踪，偶一抬头时慌忙用书卷掩住视线。
data.location: sunlit academy library study hall with tall gothic bookshelves and arched bay windows
data.action: seated at a polished oak desk, one hand holding an open leather diary while the other pushes up round glasses, glancing toward viewer with startled wide eyes
data.lighting: slanted golden afternoon sunlight filtering through diamond-paned windowpanes
data.mood: quiet scholarly charm, undercover intrigue, covert devotion
data.promptProse: Beta disguised as an academy student sits at a library desk pushing up round spectacles, surprised while writing in her notebook.
data.animaCaption: Beta adjusting her glasses while taking secret notes at an academy library desk.
